data.question: Kemiskinan di Riau dan Kepulauan Riau berapa?

value.raw_question: Kemiskinan di Riau dan Kepulauan Riau berapa?

value.sql:
SELECT T1.nama AS wilayah, T1.periode, T2.nilai
FROM provinsi AS T1
JOIN nilai_indikator AS T2 ON T1.kode = T2.kode_provinsi
WHERE T2.kode_indikator = :indikator
  AND T2.periode = :periode
  AND T2.kode_provinsi IN (:wilayah_0, :wilayah_1);

value.sql:
SELECT T1.nama AS wilayah, T2.nilai AS periode, T2.nilai AS nilai
FROM provinsi AS T1
JOIN nilai_indikator AS T2 ON T1.kode = T2.kode_provinsi
WHERE T2.kode_indikator = :indikator
  AND T2.periode = :periode
  AND T1.kode IN (:wilayah_0, :wilayah_1);

SELECT provinsi.nama AS wilayah, nilai_indikator.periode AS periode, SUM(nilai_indikator.nilai) AS nilai
FROM provinsi
JOIN nilai_indikator ON provinsi.kode = nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi
WHERE nilai_indikator.kode_indikator = :indikator
AND nilai_indikator.periode = :periode
AND nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi IN (:wilayah_0, :wilayah_1)
GROUP BY provinsi.kode, nilai_indikator.periode
ORDER BY nilai DESC;

SELECT 
    provinsi.nama AS wilayah,
    periode,
    SUM(nilai) AS nilai
FROM 
    nilai_indikator
JOIN 
    provinsi ON nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi = provinsi.kode
WHERE 
    nilai_indikator.kode_indikator = :indikator
    AND nilai_indikator.periode = :periode
    AND nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi IN (:wilayah_0, :wilayah_1)
GROUP BY 
    provinsi.nama, periode
ORDER BY 
    nilai DESC;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.nama AS wilayah, T2.nilai AS periode, T3.nilai AS nilai
FROM provinsi AS T1
JOIN nilai_indikator AS T2 ON T1.kode = T2.kode_provinsi
JOIN indikator AS T3 ON T2.kode_indikator = T3.kode
WHERE T2.kode_indikator = :indikator
  AND T2.periode = :periode
  AND T1.kode IN (:wilayah_0, :wilayah_1)
ORDER BY T3.nilai DESC;
